Consequently, visually plausible reconstructions may contain anatomically unsupported vascular detail, such as missing, spurious, or incorrectly connected vessels. We formalize a feedback-driven process in which accepted revisions persist across runs. The framework separates update targets from proposal and admission mechanisms. items.summary: While generalist vision-language-action (VLA) models have enabled diverse open-world manipulation, real-world robotic assistance requires two critical capabilities they currently lack: personalization and reliable execution. First, executing an instruction like "make me a sandwich" requires grounding subtask decomposition in persistent user preferences rather than relying on a single generic solution. items.title: RoTA-Bench: Evaluating 3D Spatial Reasoning through Interactive Projection Alignment
items.summary: Can vision-language models turn 2D observations into 3D understanding that supports precise action? This requires inferring object geometry, anticipating the effects of rotation, and refining actions through visual feedback. We introduce RoTA-Bench to evaluate these abilities through interactive 3D-to-2D projection alignment. Given a target silhouette, a model observes a rotated object and chooses successive rotations to recover the target projection within a limited action budget. items.summary: Large language model agents solve tasks through long sequences of tool calls, and the prevailing design has a single strong model generate every step, although many steps are routine enough for a much smaller model. items.title: WorldMemBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Memory of Video World Models
items.summary: As video models enable longer and more realistic interactive experiences, maintaining a world consistent with its history becomes essential. This requires both preserving previously observed content and ensuring coherent world evolution over time. World memory is a critical capability to evaluate alongside visual fidelity and video duration. We introduce WorldMemBench, a benchmark for systematically evaluating world memory in video world models. items.title: EVA-Cap: Optimizing Audiovisual Video Captioning via Event-Centric Alignment
items.summary: Recent advances in Omni Language Models (OLMs) provide a unified solution for audiovisual video captioning. Nevertheless, existing approaches predominantly treat captioning as an unstructured text generation process, neglecting the inherent semantic structure of videos and leading to suboptimal fine-grained audiovisual alignment. To bridge this gap, we propose EVA-Cap, a novel framework that decomposes captions into atomic audiovisual events and transforms unstructured text supervision into event-centric alignment. items.summary: Feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction builds 3D scenes directly from input images for novel view rendering, but learning Gaussian attributes from predicted geometry for high-quality rendering under large viewpoint changes remains challenging. items.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) can elicit specialized visual capabilities in vision-language models (VLMs), yet jointly optimizing heterogeneous objectives often introduces cross-capability gradient conflicts. Training experts independently mitigates this interference, but direct reward optimization may entangle specialized knowledge with reward-hacking biases. items.summary: We present CommerceGen-Studio, an end-to-end framework for generating commercial-grade main images for e-commerce Stock Keeping Units (SKUs). items.summary: Open-source web agents are now strong enough to execute realistic browser tasks, but training them with reinforcement learning still depends on weak supervision: binary task success is too sparse for credit assignment, while frontier-language-model judges are too expensive to call at every step and cannot be assumed available at deployment. We introduce CLIFT, a training and test-time scaling method built around conformal self-verification. items.summary: We propose DeltaStreamer, a novel agentic framework for streaming video understanding inspired by how humans observe, remember, and investigate. Streaming video understanding requires a system to retain evidence before knowing which details future queries will need. items.summary: Reinforcement learning can align visual generators with reward signals beyond their pretraining objectives, but existing score-function methods typically introduce stochasticity by perturbing the reverse denoising trajectory, leading to costly rollout-based optimization. items.summary: Video world models turn actions and camera motion into long visual rollouts, making video a natural interface for interactive simulation. Such interaction requires responsive generation, yet coherent rollouts must retain visual memory of what has already been generated. Chunked video diffusion models usually keep this context in growing KV caches, so later chunks become progressively slower. items.summary: Audio source separation models must preserve fine spectral structure while keeping the cost of the separator tractable. items.title: InfoVis: Unified Slide Image Generation and Editing
items.summary: Generating and editing presentation slides requires models to combine accurate text rendering, instruction following, visual grounding, aesthetic design, and precise editing within one canvas. Existing work covers only subsets of these capabilities and lacks large-scale slide-native supervision and diagnostic evaluation. items.summary: Rapid advances in large language models have made software engineering agents capable of tackling complex coding tasks. items.title: Memory as Weights: Internalizing Long-Term History for Streaming Videos
items.summary: Streaming vision-language models (VLMs) must continuously integrate information from the past while remaining responsive to current observations and user queries. Existing memory mechanisms typically compress, retrieve, or cache historical observations and reintroduce them into the input context, forcing historical memory and current observations to compete for limited context. items.summary: Recursive self-improvement, in which AI systems build stronger AI systems, is one promising route to superintelligence. items.summary: Visual foundation models (VFMs) are increasingly integrated into end-to-end autonomous driving for their powerful representations, yet it remains unclear when these representations improve driving performance. items.summary: We introduce 3DCodeVerse, a research ecosystem that enables coding agents to create editable and verifiable 3D content at scale. 3DCodeVerse comprises large-scale, high-quality datasets of executable 3D code, a coding harness for spatial reasoning and automated verification, and practical guidance for 3D coding. items.summary: Personalization is essential for general-purpose robots to transition into household environments and achieve true practicality. items.summary: Predicting how the world responds to an action requires more than what can be seen: robots must account for environmental factors that are neither directly observable nor explicitly specified, from physical properties such as friction and mass to human-defined environmental rules. items.summary: Generative simulation can automate robot environment construction, but physically valid environments are not necessarily useful for training. items.summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models have become an important approach for scaling model parameters. 谈了三个月的女朋友才发现她和前任有较大经济纠纷
items.summary: 谈了三个月，起初完全没提过，两个月的时候逐渐被发现一次才知道她借了几十万给一个同事，到现在对方每个月陆续还她三万到五万。约定好了如果去处理类似的问题，需要提前跟我沟通报备，不能瞒着我去解决。 前几天就出现单独去处理的情况，然后才得知还有一个谈了几个月的前男友，她也借了二十万给他，现在对方基本不还，或者还得极少。 她的钱只有几万是存的，大部分是银行大额贷款和多平台网贷。 她的理由是那两个人也是事业编，跑不掉，有家庭的，借给他们去做装修的生意。 但我芥蒂在于被隐瞒都算了，都约定好的事情还不尊重我的感受。 现在陷入了僵局，分也不是很好，父母都见过了，不分把确实有点膈应。 平时其实相处各方面还可以，性格学历比较好，外貌也比较出众。 但温柔就是很爱逃避问题也非常软弱，但我觉得也不应该牺牲我的感受。 见父母对方母亲喝酒基本上把我数落了二十分钟，基本都在骂。。哎，对方家人很不好相处。

items.title: 中药真的好败好感啊
items.summary: 平时极少生病，但每次买药看病都被中成药搞得无比烦躁。 上次腰疼去三甲医院，医生直接开了整整两大袋药。直接一千多的药费，当时刚毕业没几年，也不懂拒绝，想着反正是医保的钱，回家一数，真正管用的西药消炎药就几个，剩下的全是什么膏药、药包和中成药。不用自己煎药是挺方便，但很多中成药一天吃三次、一次要吞 2-7 片之间，加起来一次也是不小的数目，简直是当糖豆喂！还有膏药药包，想想都烦，我当时非常抗拒，最后只吃了西药，其他中药一概没动，过几天腰照样好了（当时应该是筋膜炎）。 今天降温有点感冒头疼，想着趁中午吃饭在路边药店顺手买点药（平时都用美团外卖）。我已经明确拒绝了店员推销的过敏药和维生素，结果结账还是开了三盒药，花了 80 多。 回家打开一看，两盒巨型包装的中成药，一个一天三次、一次 5-7 片，另一个也是一天三次一次 2-4 片，得，我是真不喜欢吃这么多药，效果真的也存疑。虽然刷的是医保个账，但这种被强行捆绑推销的感觉真的让人心里极度不适。 线下买药疯狂套路推销真的受够了，以后买药还是老老实实网购吧，至少耳根清净。
